mission.title: Perfect Enemy
mission.description: Find who killed an Exile leader and why, and cut Zion off from the Assassin's lair.

npc.say:
My husband is a pompous ass. He thinks he can do whatever he wants. Sometimes he forgets that I am the Queen, and we all know the Queen is the only piece with real power.
You think about that, my sweet.
Don't look at me like that! I'm only doing my job.

phase.briefing:
JC has just reported the death of an Exile leader, Dewitt. Since we would be foolish to think this was a senseless act of violence, a motive must be determined.
Talk to JC and find out what the murderer wanted. The sooner we get a trace on the killer, the sooner we can exact punishment.

enter.say: This place was hit hard. Whoever made the attack needed something -- bad.
I saw JC's RSI stream by in the code a few minutes ago. He can't be far.

talk.say:
Y-- y-- you...you're {player}, right? So Fla-- Fla-- Flood... got my ca-- ca-- call...after all.
The-- the-- they were a ma-- ma-- monster! A foul disfig--fig--figured...beast! Not of this wo-- wo-- world...or the next! He ri-- ri-- ripped out Dewitt's heart...and ga-- ga-- gave it to me! What kind of soulless cre-- cre-- creature would do that?!

done.say: Snag that heart from JC. We can use it to trace the killer's RSI signal.

talk.say: A-- a-- all I have is Dewitt's heart.

done.say: I don't know which is more disgusting: JC's sobbing or you holding a bloody heart.

phase.briefing: Bring that heart to Dr. Brent. He has hardware that can trace the RSI signal of anyone who has ever made contact with certain objects. Of course, this technology isn't perfect, but we get by.

enter.say: Dr. Brent is waiting. He can help you get that heart scanned. Whoever the killer is, they won't stay a mystery for long.

objective.text: Give Dewitt's heart to Dr. Brent

talk.say: We need to make this quick. We don't have much time if we're going to track the RSI signal from Dewitt's heart. Give it to me and we can get this started.
Come now. Give me the heart.

done.say:
Yuck! You could've at least wrapped the heart up in newspaper or something. Even a plastic container would've been nice.
It matters not now. We need to get this heart scanned into my laptop. It's nearby. Just lead me to it and we can go from there.

objective.text: Get the name of the killer

done.say: Bingo! We got him! The killer's name is Shedar. I'll pass this tasty bit of intel onto Flood and start pin-pointing Shedar's location. I should've the details on Shedar's location by the time you're outside.

Shedar, huh? Can't say I know them, or even want to know them! Especially if they're the kind of person who goes around yanking hearts from ribcages! And I thought Flood was disturbing... You won't tell him I said that, right?

phase.briefing: Shedar's RSI signal leads us to this location. Introduce yourself, find out who tipped off Shedar, and discover their motive. If a polite conversation or interrogation shed little light onto this situation, you will need to rely on an alternate means of unraveling this mystery.

enter.say: Flood is a fool if he thinks Shedar will cough up the intel without a fight. I think you'll have better luck accessing a computer system or checking Shedar's pockets.

objective.text: Get the access card from Shedar's body

done.say: Check the area for a computer and put that access card to use.

objective.text: Find out who tipped off Shedar

done.say: Everything appears nominal. Run a search on "Shedar."
With Shedar out of the way and the intel on Kore in our hands, you can proceed. Make your exit, {player}.
Our enemies no longer occupy that residence. Congratulations, {player}. You are a ruthless assassin. Do try not to get headstrong about it.

near.say: I don't know how you found me, but you won't be around to share your story after we're done killing you!

phase.briefing:
This "Kore" person has access to extremely sensitive information. Rest assured that their demise will be the final step in your assignment, but right now the hardline requires our immediate attention.
Descend upon that location, eliminate all opposition, and disable the hardline to the Assassin's lair. This will temporarily prevent Zion and Machine operatives from confronting our associate.

enter.say:
You heard the man. Find all the asses you can and kick 'em!
Oh, and don't forget the business with the hardline. I'll help you out in any way I can.

done.say: There are no more Machine enemies left to pummel into submission. Your thirst for combat knows no bounds. That is why I selected you for this assignment.
A safe combination? Check the area for a safe! It might be hidden.

objective.text: Get the computer virus from the hidden safe

done.say: That did the trick! Now snatch the goods inside the safe.
This is almost too easy! With the computer virus we can disable the hardline by infecting the local mainframe. Just find the mainframe and put that virus to work!

objective.text: Disable the hardline to the Assassin's lair

done.say: That's a wrap, {player}. Make like a baby and head out.

phase.briefing:
Now we must complete the final step: kill Kore.
Put a few extra bullets in them for me, will you?

enter.say: I have a solid lock on Kore. It's time to do the dirty deed, {player}.

talk.say:
I have been waiting for you... You look surprised to see me. Don't be.
Yes. I am "Kore." I helped Zion find the Assassin's lair. I have my reasons for doing what I've done and I will face the consequences before my husband.

done.say: The Merovingian is gonna be furious! I'll be surprised if Persephone gets away with this one.

near.say: What the hell?! Persephone is in the next room! Talk to her and find out what's going on.

mission.finish: Words fail me... I will handle this, {player}. Trust in that.
